mod.help: Settings for the Weight Multiplier mod.

mode.label: Mode
mode.help: Multiply: your equip load is multiplied. Fixed value: your equip load is always one number.

multiplier.label: Multiplier
multiplier.help: Multiplies your equip load, used when Mode is Multiply. 1 = vanilla.

fixed_value.label: Fixed Value
fixed_value.help: The equip load you always have, used when Mode is Fixed value.

log.label: Log file
log.help: Write a log file next to the DLL, for troubleshooting.
